$comment: Single source of truth for the playground. The gallery renders every entry; the build only builds entries with status 'ready'.
`id` is immutable: it is the folder name under apps/, the URL segment, and the key used to derive the GitHub + degit links.
The package manager is inferred from each app's lockfile (bun.lock, package-lock.json, pnpm-lock.yaml, yarn.lock).
Build output is assumed to be 'dist'; add "outDir" only when the toolchain differs (e.g. Next.js static export writes to 'out').

apps.name: Vanilla: Minimal Embed
apps.description: The smallest possible embed: plain TypeScript, bundled with Bun, no framework.
